import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import norm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(x):
    if not isinstance(x, np.ndarray):
        raise TypeError("x must be a numpy.ndarray")

    real_part = norm.pdf(x, loc=0, scale=1)
    imag_part = norm.pdf(x, loc=2, scale=2)
    complex_dist = real_part + 1j * imag_part

    plt.figure()
    plt.plot(x, real_part, label="Real part (mean=0, std=1)")
    plt.plot(x, imag_part, label="Imaginary part (mean=2, std=2)")
    plt.title("Complex Distribution from Two Gaussians")
    plt.xlabel("x")
    plt.ylabel("Probability Density")
    plt.legend()
    plt.grid(True)

    return complex_dist
